name: agx
tagline: One CLI for your AI coding agents and all their accounts.
description: Command-line toolkit for AI coding agents: Claude Code and Codex plan usage for every account at once, launch on the account with the most headroom, resume conversations on the right account, and manage session folders.

positioning.audience: Claude Code users who switch between several accounts (CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR)
positioning.wedge: See which account still has headroom before starting a long session, without logging into each one
differentiators: all accounts and providers in one view
auto-pick the account with the most headroom
resume conversations on the account that holds them
session folder gc and promote with history
read-only: never refreshes or rewrites tokens
